step_1_scenario_parameter.claim: The trailing '120' in the scenario id is Syndra's Splinters-of-Wrath stack count, set to the maximum.
step_1_scenario_parameter.why: Syndra's innate caps at exactly 120 Splinters, and 120 is the Transcendence threshold. The repo's own audit records the modelled knob with that exact range and value: 'splinters option (0-120)' and 'splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff'.

step_2_charge_gate.quoted_wiki_text: Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.
step_2_charge_gate.arithmetic: splinters = 120 >= 40  =>  gate OPEN  =>  Dark Sphere charges = 2
step_2_charge_gate.consequence: At 120 splinters Syndra may cast Dark Sphere twice back-to-back; the second cast is paid for out of the stocked charge, NOT gated by Dark Sphere's 7 s cooldown.

step_3_slot_vocabulary.claim: The repo names that stocked second Dark Sphere cast with the synthetic slot 'Q2', and it exists only when the 40-splinter gate is open.

step_4_timing_check.reasoning: W is a plain cooldown ability with no ammo/recharge track. Dark Sphere is the only Syndra slot with a stocked-charge track (rechargeRate 7 s, max 2 charges once splinters >= 40). Therefore the ONLY mechanism by which a second Dark Sphere can occupy the second position of a cast timeline, ahead of W, is the charge - and at splinters = 120 that mechanism is fully available with both charges banked at fight start. Under the shared-timeline rule quoted below, the old scheduling (second Dark Sphere pushed past W because Dark Sphere's 7 s cooldown had not elapsed) is exactly the artefact you get if the charge is NOT modelled.
step_4_timing_check.quoted_formula_source: docs/math-foundations.md lines 59-67: 'Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it starts within the window (_schedule_shared_casts). With c_i the effective cooldown of ability i, the cast epochs of a solo ability are 0, c_i, 2c_i, ... - again a deterministic renewal schedule; the shared-timeline version is the superposition with mutual-exclusion, resolved greedily by cast order.'

independent_computation.conclusion: For a Syndra custom cast order evaluated at 120 Splinters of Wrath, the second entry of the cast timeline being the stocked second Dark Sphere - slot 'Q2' - is game-faithful: 120 >= 40 opens the charge gate, max charges = 2, so the second Dark Sphere fires immediately rather than waiting out the 7 s cooldown behind W. The old value 'W' is the no-charge-model ordering and contradicts the quoted Transcendent Bonus text.

limitations: The scenario definition for 'syndra_custom_order_120' lives outside the permitted evidence tree (scripts/tests), so the declared custom cast order itself was not read. The verdict rests on (a) the wiki-sourced fact that at 120 splinters a second stocked Dark Sphere is available and castable without waiting the 7 s cooldown, and (b) the cached audit records establishing 'Q2' as precisely the repo's name for that second charge, gated at 40+ splinters. Both make 'Q2' at timeline index 1 the game-faithful value and 'W' the value you get only if the charge is unmodelled.

data/champions.json marks Dark Sphere's cooldown affectedByCdr=false, which conflicts with R's passive ('Dark Sphere's cooldown is reduced equivalent to an amount of ability haste'). This is a wiki-cache quirk noted in passing; it does not change the slot identity at index 1, since the second Dark Sphere here comes from the charge track, not from the cooldown elapsing.
